cards.front: Which ocular motor nerve exits from the dorsal brainstem? [___]
cards.context: Trochlear axons cross before dorsal exit. Each nucleus therefore supplies the opposite superior oblique; the peripheral nerve supplies the muscle on its own side.

reference.title: NCBI Bookshelf: ocular motor anatomy and palsy

cards.context: The optic nerve leaves the back of the globe and carries visual information from the retina towards the brain. It is distinct from the smaller motor nerve supplying lateral rectus.

reference.title: Cranial Nerves III, IV, and VI: Oculomotor Function

cards.front: The muscle marked A produces [___] of the eye.
cards.context: Lateral rectus pulls the front of the eye away from the nose. Weakness limits looking towards the affected side.
